Oh! I think it fixed itself.
Thank God, it was nothing serious.
But what the hell was that? Crashing my PC shouldn’t have anything to do with electricity going out in the whole building. 
Maybe it’s just a coincidence? 
It’s gotta be it, right?
Is my PC alright? Seems like it, everything looks normal.
This blackout wasn’t my fault after all!
